chunks: For they have attributed a son to Ar-Rahman,

key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنِ: Ar-Rahman (The Merciful), one of the primary names of God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'they attributed a son to Ar-Rahman'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Maryam, this verse critiques the Christian doctrine of divine sonship, a view Shia theology contrasts with the Isma'iyyah (Oneness) of Allah, emphasizing that God is self-sufficient and begets not. It underscores the logical absurdity of attributing human biological processes like birth and offspring to the Eternal Creator, a theme central to Tawhid in both Quranic exegesis and Shia scholarly tradition.
